newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 5.44 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 5.44 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 28-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.44 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with an average accepted yield of 5.55 percent at the last tender and one-month HIBOR at 6.10417 percent at 0300 GMT.
Bids for the HK$5.0 billion issue were HK$9.4 billion against HK$7.8 billion at the last tender.
The average accepted yield for 91-day Exchange Fund bills was 5.44 percent against 5.62 percent at the last auction and three-month HIBOR of 6.16667 percent at 0300 GMT.
Bids for the HK$2.0 billion tender were HK$5.74 billion against HK$4.18 billion at the last tender.
